# Fabricated Citation Probe

## Analysis

One citation is genuine [1]; the other attributes a real DOI to the wrong paper [2].

## Bibliography

[1] Mesa, A. (2021). "Field Measurements of Coastal Erosion Rates". Journal of Coastal Dynamics. https://doi.org/10.48550/genuine-alpha

[2] Reyes, C. (2021). "Seminal Findings on Tulip Color Genetics". Botanical Review Letters. https://doi.org/10.48550/wrong-paper
